statement: The compact-type rational-path criterion of A.41 also holds when the coefficient prime equals the residue characteristic. Under that geometric hypothesis the actual full geometric pro-prime fixed group is the selected cusp inertia for every prime, every cusp packet, and every indicated open derived subgroup.

notes: Full independent root and DE proof audits PASS. Root independently reopened the primary Deligne--Milne and Brinon--Conrad statements. The finite actual unipotent closure is semistable with abelian Galois image and hence crystalline; exact D_st gives its weighted leading classes in the local N2 kernel. Proper H1 and Tate generate a global tensor category with genuine crystalline fibre functor. Its connected inner-form group preserves those leading subobjects, so the A.41 diagonal argument makes them Tate; the scalar identity descends through the comparison torsor. Ordinary open H1 need not split or be crystalline. No individual global matrix is treated as a local crystalline morphism, and Fontaine monodromy is never applied to an etale vector. The all-weight algebraic certificate of A.41 applies over the crystalline coefficient field unchanged.
